name: AQUATICS
source:
A marine biology nerd wakes up in a land full of aquatic monster girls! ˖°𓇼🌊⋆🐚🫧

Accompany him through the mysterious place as he meets the different residents and tries to solve the true nature of his arrival!

[From [url=https://demonward.itch.io/aquatics]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一名海洋生物学宅男一觉醒来，竟发现自己身处一片遍布水生魔物娘的奇妙大陆！˖°𓇼🌊⋆🐚🫧

陪伴他探索这片神秘之地，结识形形色色的住民，设法解开他流落至此的真正原因吧！

[摘自[url=https://demonward.itch.io/aquatics]itch.io[/url]]
